title: Case 002: Expected Incoming Payment
initial_request: I’m expecting a contribution toward the cost of a shared pottery studio kiln. The sender told me by phone that they had transferred it, but I can’t see it in my H&V account; please check whether it has arrived.
overview: Elowen Marsh contacted H&V through secure chat to escalate an expected payment after the sender said by phone that they had made a transfer. The agent checked incoming credits for Elowen’s account and reported the result through the secure portal. The check found no incoming payment at that time; the sender’s payment instruction could not be confirmed from H&V’s records.

next_action.summary: Check H&V’s incoming-payment records for Elowen’s account and report the current status through the secure portal.

outcome: H&V’s check found no incoming payment to Elowen’s account at the time of review. This does not establish whether the sender made or completed a payment; its status with the sender or their bank remains unknown.

events.body: I’ve sent the contribution for the kiln by bank transfer.
I’m escalating this because the contribution for our pottery studio kiln still isn’t showing in my account. The sender told me they transferred it, so please check whether H&V has received it.
I’m checking incoming credits recorded for Elowen Marsh’s account now. I’ll report only what H&V’s records show.
No incoming payment found for the account at the time of this check.

I checked the incoming payments recorded for your account, and no incoming payment was found at the time of the check. This confirms only what H&V can see; I can’t determine from our records whether the sender made or completed the payment.
